third_channel_margin_caveat: both axes read 0.7714 vs GRANULARITY and vs the lobe representative — below the 0.80 ceiling but ONE attainable rank-step below it at N=6. The pre-commitment STANDS on a real margin, and that margin is thin; the recurring A2 obligation re-measures these at every census growth alongside the staked correlations.

two_gate_restatement.why: the hashed flat threshold and the R4 seed floor are different gates; the boundary report stated only one. Both were measured and both apply.
two_gate_restatement.RAKING_DIRECTIONAL_SPAN: effect 0.91093 >= required 0.25 (floor 0.00579 x 2.0 -> bar dominates) AND exceeds hashed flat threshold — clears both gates
two_gate_restatement.RAKING_SHADOW_FRACTION: effect 0.50406 >= required 0.25 AND exceeds hashed threshold — clears both gates. CAVEAT: its seed floor measured literally 0.0 — all six flat members produce identical shadow fractions at 32x32 grid resolution, so the statistic is quantization-coarse on flat subjects and its margin gate reduces to the bar; recorded, not smoothed over.

third_channel_ruling_SUPERSEDED.physical_reading: micro-normal amplitude IS surface relief; raking light measures relief shadowing and GRANULARITY measures relief texture contrast — two optics on one physical quantity. Under a relief driver they must track, and they do.
third_channel_ruling_SUPERSEDED.ruling: THE CROSSING PRE-COMMITMENT IS VOID — decided at commissioning, as point 3 required
